title: Prove Feuerbach distance relations via coordinate computation

problemStatement.plain: The nine-point circle is tangent to the incircle and all three excircles. Core distance relations: |NI| = |R/2 - r| and |NI_a| = R/2 + r_a.

Key chain: bilinearity → |u|^2 = R^2*s^2 - sigma → sigma_identity → Heron → NI^2 = (R/2-r)^2
